title: Passes
description: Tokyo Tower seen from the street between two building faces, and a sun you can move. Drag and the sun swings around the canyon: across is where it stands, from behind your left shoulder through straight ahead, behind the tower, to behind your right; up and down is how high. The concrete takes its warm light from the surface normals a renderer would keep: sunlit concrete goes to a warm stone and the faces turned away to a cool grey, held far below the sky's own blue. The tower stays the photograph, matted at the source's full resolution with the haze unmixed from every girder, its light only tinted by the sun's and dimmed when the sun stands behind it: the one sharp thing in the frame. The plate's flat sky is replaced by a photographed summer cumulus dome, looked up along each pixel's true ray so the clouds converge with the walls, and turned with the sun so its piled cumulus towers on the sun's side behind the tower, sunlit crowns over skylit blue bases, under a canyon of deep cobalt.
intent: Reality pieces: the layers under a captured image, after Unreal's buffer visualization (https://dev.epicgames.com/documentation/en-us/unreal-engine/viewport-modes-in-unreal-engine), photogrammetry tools like Polycam and RealityScan, and Thomas Ruff's jpegs, where the image's structure becomes the image. Photo by Jakob Owens on Unsplash; sky from Poly Haven's Rural Asphalt Road (Alexander Scholten, CC0). Depth by Depth Anything V2, normals by MoGe-2, mattes by SAM 2.1, baked offline.
